ITEM 1 | Cooked strips of reddish-brown meat with crisp, browned edges and a glossy, slightly oily sheen, arranged in a folded cluster about 9 cm long and 6 cm wide on a white square plate roughly 22 cm across; pieces are flat and thin (about 0.3 cm thick), holding their shape with a layered, ribbon-like structure and some lighter pale fatty streaks | 40

ITEM 2 | Small scattered droplets of orange-red, translucent liquid (about 5 mm each) spread across the plate surface around the meat, appearing thin and watery with slight sheen | 3

ITEM 3 | Faint smear of pale yellowish grease or residue along the left edge of the plate, flat and thin with no defined shape | 1
